packageRules.description: A major waits for the owner: no auto-merge, and a label that names it.
Each update of a workflow's action touches a path of CODEOWNERS and waits for the owner: they come in one pull request a week. A major stays apart, under the rule above.
factory/templates/ holds the trial repository's files as they ran there: an update is played in the trial first, then copied by hand.
